'''Shohn-Lowt''' was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] active during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Tyrant" /> Around [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|3}}</ref> during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]], he was hunting the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[the Tyrant]], who had escaped from [[the Tomb]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. He was injured in the pursuit and asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizen to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Tyrant.<ref name="Tyrant" />
